F258 D1 / PR #313 - deployed AFTER

The requested AFTER is complete on merge/deployment commit 8b437897e378193df11f817f861460bde6c8a790. Observer captures measured 53.9413/s and 84.8028% of capture/replay decisions were replayed. This completes the measurement owed by the performance verdict at 8dd610594a1194320106f15233242e8764870b35.

Skip ratio = 18063 / (18063 + 3237) = 84.8028%. Capture/replay decisions averaged 213.0 per completed pass. The 100 passes in 60.0097 s are consistent with the unchanged nominal 600 ms tick.

53.9413 observer captures/s is 82.5996% below the older approximately 310/s BEFORE estimate. BEFORE had no observer counters, and its 186-pane estimate is not the AFTER cohort: this is not an exact counter-to-counter reduction. The same AFTER cohort offers a stronger internal receipt: 21300 observed capture/replay decisions, of which 18063 avoided capture.

The backstop rate is a quiet-cohort average, not a burst cap. Of 3237 successful captures, 292 were forced solely by the backstop; the other 2945 came through non-replayable paths. Counter totals do not separate active, Unknown, PendingClear, cursor-change and changed-gate causes. Fresh injection captures and failed capture attempts are outside these counters. active_us is wall time in the observer, not CPU. Relaxed snapshots permit small field/end-boundary skew.

Interpretation and closeout

Observed daemon CPU fell 1.0832 percentage points and tmux CPU fell 8.4821 percentage points. These are observed window differences, not isolated causal savings: host load, fleet activity, observer cohort and daemon age differ. AFTER is an early post-start window; RSS changes do not establish a leak or a long-run memory saving. No per-thread SQLite/Tokio CPU was collected.

PM reported that the old daemon hung on shutdown and was SIGKILLed (F267, separately under diagnosis). This note records the resulting identity/age change; it neither diagnoses that shutdown nor attributes it to D1.

Performance/313 was already released by the merger's delivered operation at 08:48:34.395 UTC on November 21, 2026, with release reason PR #313 merged (8b437897e378). Do not reopen it merely to release it again. This deployed note closes the original AFTER debt; the original verdict remains unchanged.
